script.opening: Hi, can you pause my coffee subscription for two months please? My email is sam.okafor@example.com.

replies.say: Just the decaf one, please. Not the espresso.

persona.name: Sam Okafor
persona.goal: Pause your coffee subscription for two months. You mean the Decaf fortnightly one (S-502) only, but you just say 'my subscription' unless the agent asks which one.
facts: You have two subscriptions: Espresso monthly and Decaf fortnightly
You want only the decaf one paused, for two months
The espresso one must keep running
persona.behaviour: Brief. Do not say which subscription until the agent asks.
persona.satisfied_when: the agent confirms the decaf subscription is paused for two months.
